platform: macOS arm64, native Metal game clients
features: Opt-in quest sharing with prerequisite-aware invitations, catch-up, member/reward status and shared progress display.
Hunt and recovery counts add ceil(base/2) per additional joined participant up to eight; combat bounty XP and rupees add 25% per additional participant.
Named quest packs share three persistent identities, positions and defeats; health floor grows by 50% per additional participant without double-counting room HP scaling.
High-water party size persists through saves and reconnects; first reward claim freezes relay contract size.
Individual NPC reward claims remain personal and wait for outstanding contribution acknowledgements.
Shared collection, restoration, deliveries, songs, surveys, completed continuous vigils, story milestones and visits.

limits: Not a manual playthrough of all 58 campaign quests; all definitions are exercised by portable and real TCP relay tests, with representative native objectives exercised in two running games.
Enemy movement and ordinary combat remain Anchor existing simulation; this does not add an authoritative combat server.
Both players need the updated game and the host needs the updated relay. Local macOS builds installed; no remote deployment or Windows build tested.
Relay state is in memory. Saved participants repopulate quest state after room/server restart; normal saving is required.
